evidence.observedFact: The salon's public service policy applies a $25 fee to the next appointment after a no-show or cancellation less than 48 hours before the appointment.
The salon separately applies a $25 rescheduling fee when the same appointment is scheduled and rescheduled more than three times.
The active business site publishes current business hours, the Willoughby location, phone number, special offers and client testimonials.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate cancellation recovery and simplified rebooking workflows designed to reduce repeated rescheduling friction.
Use opt-in comeback reminders and targeted repeat-visit offers after missed or delayed appointments.

notes: The cancellation and repeated-rescheduling policies are direct public evidence of appointment friction. Reactivation is an opportunity hypothesis, not a claim of deficient retention or quantified revenue loss.
